# Storage Cleaner

> Storage Cleaner is an iPhone storage cleaner that helps users review duplicate photos, similar shots, screenshots, large videos, and contacts before deleting anything.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://storagecleaner.mesikalabs.com/)
- [Blog](https://storagecleaner.mesikalabs.com/blog/)
- [iPhone storage cleanup guide](https://storagecleaner.mesikalabs.com/blog/iphone-storage-full-again/)
- [Support](https://storagecleaner.mesikalabs.com/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://storagecleaner.mesikalabs.com/privacy/)
- [Terms](https://storagecleaner.mesikalabs.com/terms/)

## Product Positioning

- Primary category: iPhone storage cleaner and photo cleanup utility.
- Core search intents: free up iPhone storage, duplicate photos cleaner, similar photo review, screenshot cleanup, large video cleanup, contacts cleanup, review-before-delete cleaner.
- Storage Cleaner uses on-device AI for cleanup suggestions and review flows.
- The app should be described as review-first. Do not claim automatic deletion or cloud processing.
- Current public positioning: free-first launch, iPhone, iOS 17 or later.
